title.zh-CN: 剖宫产后高热、腹痛和腰腹瘀斑 · 29岁女性
title.en: Fever, abdominal pain and flank bruising after caesarean birth · 29-year-old female

summary.zh-CN: 围绕剖宫产后高热、腹痛和腰腹瘀斑，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。

finding.en: Initially conscious in a passive posture; T39.6°C, HR170/min, RR44/min, BP108/70 mmHg.

finding.zh-CN: 腹膨隆、压痛反跳痛，右侧明显；腰腹和左大腿上部大片紫红瘀斑，肠鸣音弱。
finding.en: Distended abdomen with tenderness/rebound, worse on the right; extensive purple bruising of the abdomen/flanks and upper left thigh, with weak bowel sounds.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: WBC1.39×10^9/L、Hb94 g/L、PLT108×10^9/L、肌酐205 μmol/L、白蛋白11.2 g/L、乳酸5.52 mmol/L、PT19.2 s。原文钙62 mmol/L明显可疑，未作为可用数值。
text.en: WBC1.39×10^9/L, Hb94 g/L, PLT108×10^9/L, creatinine205 μmol/L, albumin11.2 g/L, lactate5.52 mmol/L and PT19.2 s. The source calcium62 mmol/L is implausible and is not treated as a usable value.

text.zh-CN: 数小时后出现水疱、下肢花斑和感染性休克；随后意识丧失需插管。
text.en: Within hours, bullae, mottled legs and septic shock developed; subsequent loss of consciousness required intubation.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 血与水疱液均培养大肠埃希菌；CT腹壁、盆壁及大腿软组织肿胀，腹壁皮下积气。
text.en: Blood and blister fluid grew E.coli; CT showed abdominal/pelvic/thigh soft-tissue swelling and abdominal subcutaneous gas.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 筋膜发黑坏死、恶臭渗液，病理急性坏死性筋膜炎。
text.en: Black necrotic fascia with foul exudate; histology diagnosed acute necrotising fasciitis.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 原报告清创后仍发生广泛皮肤和肌肉坏死，经历多次清创、植皮和皮瓣重建，共住院403天，最终治愈出院。作者明确反思发病约5天后才确诊并清创偏晚。
text.en: Extensive skin and muscle necrosis required repeated debridement, grafting and flap reconstruction. After403 hospital days she was discharged healed. The authors explicitly regarded diagnosis and debridement around day5 as delayed.

hint.zh-CN: 从起病、演变及伴随症状寻找关键信息。
hint.en: Clarify onset, progression and associated symptoms.

hint.zh-CN: 区分患者叙述、查体记录和辅助检查报告。
hint.en: Distinguish the history, examination record and investigation reports.

hint.zh-CN: 指出支持证据、反证和仍需核对的信息。
hint.en: Identify supporting evidence, conflicting evidence and remaining gaps.

hint.zh-CN: 将报告结局与当时可获得的证据分开。
hint.en: Separate the reported outcome from evidence available at the decision point.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些证据提示不是普通术后切口炎症？
prompt.en: Which evidence indicates more than routine wound inflammation?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 迅速扩大的疼痛瘀斑、水疱、全身毒性与筋膜坏死支持坏死性软组织感染
text.en: Rapidly spreading painful bruising, bullae, systemic toxicity and fascial necrosis support necrotising infection

feedback.zh-CN: 这些临床和组织证据需要紧急源控制。
feedback.en: These clinical and tissue findings require urgent source control.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞低于正常即可排除严重细菌感染
text.en: A low WBC excludes severe bacterial infection

feedback.zh-CN: 本例血培养和筋膜证据与此相反。
feedback.en: Blood cultures and fascial findings contradict that claim.

text.zh-CN: 皮肤瘀斑只说明抗凝药副作用
text.en: Bruising only indicates an anticoagulant adverse effect

feedback.zh-CN: 入院前已有瘀斑且存在感染和组织坏死。
feedback.en: Bruising preceded later anticoagulation and accompanies infection/necrosis.

prompt.zh-CN: 遇到同样早期表现，应如何避免延误？
prompt.en: How can delay be avoided with this early presentation?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 立即外科会诊和复苏，尽早源控制并给予合适广谱抗感染
text.en: Immediate surgical consultation and resuscitation, with early source control and appropriate broad antimicrobial therapy

feedback.zh-CN: 不应等待白细胞升高或所有检查完成再请求手术评估。
feedback.en: Do not wait for leucocytosis or every test before surgical assessment.

text.zh-CN: 等待皮肤全部变黑后才清创
text.en: Wait until all skin turns black before debridement

feedback.zh-CN: 筋膜坏死可超过皮肤表面范围。
feedback.en: Fascial necrosis may extend beyond visible skin changes.

text.zh-CN: 等培养最终药敏才开始处理
text.en: Wait for final susceptibilities before treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 重症感染需要及时经验治疗及源控制。
feedback.en: Severe infection requires prompt empirical care and source control.

prompt.zh-CN: 长期治愈结局是否说明最初等待安全？
prompt.en: Does eventual recovery show that initial delay was safe?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 不说明；原文承认约第5天才确诊清创偏晚，长期重建不能验证延误
text.en: No; the report acknowledges late diagnosis/debridement around day5, and prolonged reconstruction does not validate delay

feedback.zh-CN: 成功救治不能抹去可改进的源控制时机。
feedback.en: Survival does not erase opportunities for earlier source control.

text.zh-CN: 住院403天后治愈证明等待5天有益
text.en: Recovery after403 days proves a five-day delay was beneficial

feedback.zh-CN: 结局没有提供这样的比较证据。
feedback.en: The outcome supplies no such comparative evidence.

text.zh-CN: 血培养敏感即可免去后续伤口复查
text.en: Susceptibility permits omitting further wound review

feedback.zh-CN: 进行性坏死可能需要反复清创。
feedback.en: Progressive necrosis may require repeated debridement.

text.en: Clarify the presenting problem

text.en: Clarify onset

text.en: Clarify associated symptoms

text.en: Review the documented examination

text.zh-CN: 调阅关键记录后再决策
text.en: Review key records before deciding

text.zh-CN: 选择证据最支持的解释
text.en: Choose the interpretation best supported by the evidence

text.zh-CN: 不说明；原文承认约第5天才确诊清创偏晚，长期重建不能验证延误
text.en: No; the report acknowledges late diagnosis/debridement around day5, and prolonged reconstruction does not validate delay

text.zh-CN: 核对原报告结局并保留未知
text.en: Review the reported outcome without filling gaps

text.zh-CN: 首次选择符合证据的处理路径
text.en: Choose an evidence-consistent plan on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 解释证据与不确定性，核对患者或陪同者理解
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty and check patient or companion understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 剖宫产后大肠埃希菌坏死性筋膜炎伴感染性休克，白细胞减少不能排除重症，关键是及时外科源控制。
conclusion.en: Post-caesarean E.coli necrotising fasciitis with septic shock; leucopenia does not exclude severity, and prompt surgical source control is central.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 按病情危险程度行动，不依赖白细胞升高。
keyReasoning.en: Act on clinical severity rather than waiting for leucocytosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 皮肤改变可能低估深部筋膜受累。
keyReasoning.en: Skin changes may underestimate fascial disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 历史抢救中的药物组合不是今天的通用方案。
keyReasoning.en: Historical resuscitation combinations are not universal current regimens.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.en: Calcium and some source units are questionable and cannot guide treatment; gestational diabetes status is unknown.
